title.zh: Binance MiCA Application Faces ECB Concerns in Greece - The Cryptonomist
title.en: Binance MiCA Application Faces ECB Concerns in Greece - The Cryptonomist

current_state.zh: 币安在希腊的MiCA申请在据报欧洲央行行长拉加德高层干预后陷入停滞，尽管此前监管机构认为申请已完整。
current_state.en: Binance's MiCA application in Greece is stalled following reported high-level ECB intervention by President Lagarde, despite prior regulatory completeness.

updates.title_zh: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
updates.title_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
updates.what_changed_zh: 欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德亲自干预阻止币安欧盟MiCA牌照，导致希腊搁置此前监管机构认为已完成的申请，据《华尔街日报》。
updates.what_changed_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde personally intervened to block Binance's EU MiCA license, leading Greece to stall an application regulators had previously deemed complete, according to the WSJ.
